title: Apollo 17 landing site (Moon)

place.label: Taurus-Littrow, the Moon
place.basis: Latitude and longitude as published by NSSDCA, referenced to the DE421 Mean Earth/Polar Axis lunar reference frame

measures.label: Latitude and longitude on the Moon

facts.text: NSSDCA's Apollo table lists Apollo 17: launched 7 December 1972, landed 11 December 1972 at Taurus-Littrow (20.191 N, 30.772 E).

tiers.everyday: Apollo 17 landed on the Moon on 11 December 1972 in Taurus-Littrow. NASA lists the site at 20.191 N, 30.772 E on the Moon.
tiers.student: NSSDCA's Apollo table lists a launch on 7 December 1972, 22.07 hours of moonwalk time, a traverse length [UNKNOWN] and 110.52 kg of samples. Coordinates use the DE421 Mean Earth/Polar Axis frame.

unknowns: IAU Gazetteer name for this landing point: not looked up [UNKNOWN] (only the Apollo 11 name was checked)
Traverse length: the NSSDCA table prints it with the digits after the decimal point missing (the page prints "35.")
